cold_open.hook: Oil prices just tanked on Iran peace deal hopes—because nothing says 'geopolitical stability' like betting your portfolio on diplomatic theater that could collapse in 48 hours.

markets.macro_note: Small caps outrunning large caps on Iran deal optimism; energy sector taking the hit; VIX flat at 16.69—market pricing in 'maybe peace, maybe not.'

big_story.story_title: White House says Iran deal could take days
big_story.angle: The real question isn't whether a deal happens—it's whether markets are front-running a negotiation that could blow up tomorrow, and what happens to oil, defense stocks, and geopolitical risk when the White House's timeline meets reality.

quick_hits.angle: Three big things to watch in equities this week: earnings season, rate expectations, and whether the 'underdogs driving S&P profit growth' narrative holds or cracks under scrutiny.
